title: Queue from Two Stacks
statement: Process q operations on a queue: ENQ x pushes x, DEQ pops front and prints it (or NONE if empty).

io_format.input_description: Line 1: q. Next q lines: ENQ x or DEQ.

reference_solutions.python:
import sys
from collections import deque
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().splitlines()
q = int(lines[0])
d = deque()
out = []
for i in range(1, 1+q):
    parts = lines[i].split()
    if parts[0] == 'ENQ':
        d.append(int(parts[1]))
    else:
        out.append(str(d.popleft()) if d else 'NONE')
print('\n'.join(out))
